items.quote: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time
items.claim: The angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven

items.quote: for because thou hast done this thing
and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son
items.claim: Abraham refrained from withholding his son

items.quote: in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed
items.claim: The LORD will bless Abraham and multiply his descendants

items.quote: thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies
items.claim: Abraham's descendants will possess their enemies' gates

items.quote: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed
items.claim: All nations will receive blessing through Abraham's seed
items.actor: all the nations of the earth

items.quote: because thou hast obeyed my voice
